description:
Moku is a fast, minimal manga reader frontend for Suwayomi-Server.


Moku is a fast, minimal manga reader frontend for Suwayomi-Server.

It wraps Suwayomi's GraphQL API in a lightweight Tauri app — no Electron overhead.
# Moku v0.14.1
**Released:** October 24, 2026
> "Nothing gets lost anymore."

## Highlights
• **Reading progress you can trust**：finished chapters no longer flip back to unread, and bookmarks, open reading sessions and final positions are saved on quit and close
• **Smoother anime playback**：seeking and intro skips no longer flash black, and the player remembers your subtitle and source choices
• **Safer backend**：Tsunagu 0.6.0 blocks cross-site requests to its API and only listens on this computer by default
• **Cleaner chapter syncing**：chapters a source re-IDs or drops are cleaned up, and adding a series no longer floods the Updates tab

## New Features
• Updates now use the date the server first saw a chapter, so undated chapters (like oneshots) stop showing up under Today
• Reading stats are kept when history is cleared
• The anime player remembers your subtitle language (or Off) and your preferred source between episodes
• Added an `allowed_origins` setting to Tsunagu for opening it from web pages hosted on other sites

## Improvements
• Preferred scanlator now replaces other groups' copies of a chapter instead of moving the whole group to the front
• The chapter cap keeps unread chapters and no longer deletes what download-ahead just fetched
• Novel support and sandbox memory settings apply without restarting the server
• Library updates skip local series, and a failing source waits for its interval instead of being retried every check
• Deleting a repository keeps its installed extensions as sideloaded
• Faster chapter and download lists
• Shutdown no longer waits on in-progress downloads
• Play/pause overlay icons are now rounded squares

## Bug Fixes
• Fixed progress updates marking finished chapters and episodes unread
• Fixed bookmarks, reader resume and series settings getting lost between the reader and the series page
• Fixed the open reading session and recent bookmarks being lost on quit
• Fixed restoring a backup erasing reading history
• Fixed read chapters still counting as unread in the Library and Updates
• Fixed the novel reader not resuming and loading the first chapter twice
• Fixed Home being unreachable when another default view is set
• Fixed the anime player saving position 0 on source switch, seek bar lag and stale subtitles
• Fixed anime source fallback skipping earlier sources
• Fixed duplicate download jobs and half-downloaded chapters showing as downloaded
• Fixed same-numbered chapters from different groups sharing a download folder
• Fixed failed downloads being reported as queued, download auto-retry turning off after relaunch, and missed completions
• Fixed retrying a download removing it when the storage prompt is cancelled
• Fixed storage settings freezing the window, and migrating downloads into a nested folder deleting the copy
• Fixed library update polling continuing after leaving Recent
• Fixed restart after an update leaving the server running, and unverified installer downloads
• Fixed intermittent "database locked" errors
• Fixed the sandbox being shut down for inactivity in the middle of a library update
• Fixed failed extension updates unloading the working extension
• Fixed sideloaded JS novel plugins being lost after restart
• Fixed mirrored repos overwriting each other's extensions
• Fixed redirected HLS/DASH streams, signed DASH segments, and HLS streams without `.m3u8` in their URL
• Fixed image and stream proxies being able to reach local network addresses
• Fixed Aniyomi protobuf repos and subtitle hosts that need the video's headers
• Fixed the Flatpak build on the GNOME 50 runtime
• Fixed the Unhide button for custom folders

## Notes
• Tsunagu now listens on `127.0.0.1` by default. The bundled backend and Docker are unaffected, but standalone setups that are reached from other devices need `http_addr = ":6007"` in `tsunagu.toml`
• Picking a subtitle track in the player now also updates "Preferred subtitle language" and "Enable subtitles by default" in Player settings
• The Windows restart-after-update flow was reworked and needs broader testing, please report any issues
• Cloudflare/FlareSolverr support is functional but pending broader user testing
• Anime player upscaling is still work in progress and untested

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/moku-project/Moku/compare/v0.14.0...v0.14.1
